subject.title: fix(cron): exclude lane waits from setup timeout

question: Should operator cancellation remain an internal cron scheduling decision, or should OpenClaw publish operatorCancelled as part of the CronRunOutcome contract?
rationale: The merged focused repair intentionally excluded this API and behavior change, so deciding its permanent boundary requires maintainer intent rather than an incidental follow-up to the watchdog bug.

options.title: Keep cancellation internal
options.body: Split or rework the change so cron handles terminal cancellation without extending CronRunOutcome, then add focused upgrade-safe runtime proof.

options.title: Adopt a public outcome contract
options.body: Keep operatorCancelled only after explicitly defining its callers, compatibility expectations, and tests across cron outcome consumers.

recommendation.title: Keep cancellation internal
recommendation.body: Split or rework the change so cron handles terminal cancellation without extending CronRunOutcome, then add focused upgrade-safe runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the merged focused repair and explicitly recorded the decision to defer the remaining semantics.
